security.title: Sign-in, members & security
items: Every operator is a Supabase Auth user; the app loads a profiles row (is_admin, feature_overrides) after sign-in.
Only admins may open /admin and /control; route checks use profiles.is_admin, not Control toggles alone.
Control toggles and localStorage shape default UI for this browser; non-admin permissions also merge feature_overrides from the server.
Sign-in uses a synthetic email: username@members.stockpilot.local — create the Auth user with that email pattern.
Never put the service role key or plaintext operator passwords in VITE_* env or bundled client code; member creation uses the create-member Edge Function with the service role on the server.
Bootstrap the fixed admin in Supabase Dashboard (Auth → Users) or a one-off script: set user_metadata username and is_admin true; password only in Auth.
Logout clears the session from this browser; see Supabase Auth docs for refresh tokens and RLS.

migrationGuide.title: Migration checklist
migrationGuide.subtitle: Move from your old system into StockPilot in a safe order. Check items off as you go.
migrationGuide.intro: Follow these steps to load master data before documents and money. Use CSV import where the app offers it; export from each list first if you want a column template. You can leave this page anytime—your checks are saved in this browser.
migrationGuide.savedLocallyHint: Progress is stored only on this device (localStorage). It is not synced to your account or other browsers.
migrationGuide.resetConfirmDescription: This clears all checkmarks in this browser. It does not delete any data in StockPilot.
migrationGuide.markAllConfirmDescription: Use this if you have already finished migration and only want the checklist to show 100% complete.

plan_exports.title: Export and clean data from the old system
plan_exports.body: Pull customer/supplier lists with consistent phone numbers (used for matching), product codes/SKUs, units, and any opening stock figures. Normalize dates and currencies to match how you will import. Decide what is truly “historical only” vs what you will operate going forward.

env_schema.title: Database and app environment ready
env_schema.body: Ensure Supabase (or your hosted project) has all migrations applied so draft POs, warehouses, registers, and CSV features work. Configure environment variables and sign in. Admins may use the dashboard Connect string for schema pushes; routine data loading should stay in the app.

warehouses.title: Create warehouses and registers
warehouses.body: Define each location with a clear code and name. Mark which warehouses have a cash register—orders, payments, and register activity depend on this. Do this before order/PO CSV so every row can map to a warehouse code.

categories_brands.title: Categories and brands (if needed)
categories_brands.body: Create categories and brands before or during product import. Product CSV can create missing brand/category names on the fly; pre-creating them keeps naming tidy.

people.title: Import or add customers and suppliers
people.body: Load People before order and PO CSV. Phone is the primary match key and is required when creating a new person from CSV. Suppliers must exist (with supplier role) before purchase order import creates linked POs.

products.title: Import products and opening stock
products.body: Use Products → Import CSV. Set opening quantities per warehouse when you want live on-hand stock from day one. Export CSV from the products page if you need a template. Resolve cost and list prices so later sales and PO lines are coherent.

payments_optional.title: Optional: standalone payments for opening balances
payments_optional.body: If you need opening customer or supplier balances on the ledger without tying to an order, use Payments → Import CSV where available. Complex split tenders from the old system are often easier to recreate in the UI than in bulk.

po_csv.title: Purchase orders (CSV)
po_csv.body: On Purchase orders → list, use Import CSV after suppliers and products exist. Choose Live (draft) for POs you will receive in the app—stock and payables update on confirm/receive. Choose Historical for backfill analytics only (no stock or supplier ledger). Use Export CSV on the same page for column headers.

orders_csv.title: Sales orders (CSV)
orders_csv.body: On Orders → list, use Import CSV after customers and products exist. Live creates drafts—stock and register change only when you complete/checkout like a normal order. Historical adds completed orders for charts without moving stock or posting register lines. Export CSV for a matching template.

register.title: Reconcile the register / cash drawer
register.body: Historical imports do not set physical cash. After cutover, compare the Register screen to your actual drawer and use deposits or withdrawals (if your process allows) so tender balances match reality. Link payments to the correct register warehouse when recording money in.

smoke_test.title: Smoke test in the live flows
smoke_test.body: Create one small draft sale and one draft PO in the normal screens, then complete them end-to-end. Verify stock movement, person balance, and register lines match expectations before relying on bulk data.

control_review.title: Review Control (feature flags)
control_review.body: Open Control and confirm which CSV imports, hub shortcuts, and POS actions are enabled for your team. Turn off anything you do not want clerks to see during stabilization.
